source: Anastasia Kireeva, Randomstrasse 101, 2026-06-05, first displayed Open Problem 35 in Low-degree hardness of finding the largest clique in Erdos-Renyi graph (problems 36-38)

unchanged_count.reason: The remaining obligation changed materially: full negative association was weakened to the exact standard NUOD/upper-cylinder condition for universal matched-independent chi-square domination in the forced-support channel; the necessity direction was proved; the Mao/Che-Xu order/channel boundary was isolated; and a genuinely nonexchangeable strongly-Rayleigh weighted spanning-tree instantiation was derived exactly.

methods.B4: Identified Bernoulli negative upper orthant dependence (NUOD), equivalently Pr(S subset A)<=prod_{e in S}q_e for every cylinder, as the exact weakest standard condition for universal matched-independent chi-square/Renyi-2 domination in the forced-support channel. Proved necessity by a leading-coefficient argument after restricting the noise/null weights to a violating subset. Also recorded the direct Fourier submultiplicativity sufficient condition for arbitrary product-Bernoulli pairs.
methods.B22: Used Che-Xu's current Renyi failure regime to delimit the order scope: the proof is protected at order two by a positive polynomial expansion and must not be extrapolated to KL or arbitrary divergences. Used Mao's exact degree-one matching to prove that his nontrivial counterexample cannot be represented by any monotone forced-support perturbation of G(n,1/2), independent of the support dependence assumption.
methods.B15: Constructed a nonexchangeable strongly-Rayleigh weighted spanning-tree support on K_n with vertex weights w_i and proved Z=(prod_i w_i)W^(n-2), q_ij=(w_i+w_j)/W, and sum q_ij^2=1+(n-2)sum w_i^2/W^2. For half the vertices weight 1 and half weight 2 this is 19/9-20/(9n), yielding bounded full chi-square at fixed product-null density.

new_mathematical_results: Exact forced-support boundary theorem: NUOD iff sum_S t_S Pr(S subset A)^2 <= prod_e(1+t_e q_e^2) for every nonnegative t, iff every heterogeneous product-Bernoulli/null-resampling instance is Renyi-2 dominated by the marginal-matched independent support law.
Source-style NUOD corollary: D2(TP||Q) <= rho_*^2 Adv_{<=D}(P,Q)^2 for every D>=1, so bounded source-scale LDA gives a uniform total-variation gap even with no noise and vanishing LDA gives TV->0.
Representation-free sufficient condition: on a product-Bernoulli null, squared likelihood-ratio Fourier coefficients satisfying |Lhat(S)|^2 <= prod_{e in S}|Lhat({e})|^2 give the same Renyi-2 bound.

Channel exclusion for Mao: in every monotone forced-support model, Adv_{<=1}=0 forces all support marginals to zero and hence P=Q, so Mao's nontrivial exact-moment-matching graph law necessarily lies outside this protected positive channel.
Nonexchangeable weighted-tree formulas: for Pr(T) proportional to prod_{ij in T}w_iw_j, q_ij=(w_i+w_j)/W and S2=1+(n-2)sum_i w_i^2/W^2; the 1/2 weight split gives S2=19/9-20/(9n).
failed_routes: Full negative association is not minimal; NUOD alone is sufficient and exact for the universal matched-independent comparison.
The NUOD/product-moment mechanism itself is classical negative-dependence machinery and is not claimed novel.
Che-Xu shows that matched-independent domination under negative dependence cannot be naively extended from integer Renyi orders to lower fractional orders or KL in general channels.
NUOD is not claimed necessary for Kireeva's unrestricted source problem; its necessity theorem is channel-specific.
The weighted spanning-tree example is breadth evidence only because strongly-Rayleigh spanning-tree theory and planted spanning-tree detection both have substantial prior art.
source_status: Live Randomstrasse page rechecked 2026-09-17 and still displays the general framework question as Open Problem 35; bounded later-literature search found no post-Mao source-complete characterization.
audit_status: 0/2 qualifying independent full theorem/source audits recovered
prior_art_status: NUOD/negative orthant inequalities and NA implications are classical (Joag-Dev-Proschan 1983); Bernoulli upper-cylinder-to-independent-MGF bounds are classical Chernoff machinery; Borcea-Branden-Liggett 2009 gives strongly-Rayleigh/determinantal spanning-tree negative dependence; Che-Xu arXiv:2609.01944 gives close matched-independent Renyi domination under NA in differential privacy with explicit lower-order failure regimes; Addario-Berry et al. arXiv:2602.07669 study planted spanning-tree detection. The exact forced-support low-degree/NUOD equivalence was not located in the bounded search, but novelty remains UNVERIFIED.
